guitar.evidence: Brian May's homemade "Red Special" guitar is one of the most iconic and well-documented instruments in rock history.

tone.target: hard classic-rock crunch with dry upper mids
tone.profile: hard classic-rock crunch with dry upper mids
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial drive, followed by the UK 45 amp model and UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet to achieve the desired Plexi bite and raw arena rock attack.

rig.name: Queen - Tie Your Mother Down - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain riffing and eliminate hum.
Provide initial aggressive crunch and tighten the attack for palm-muted riffs.
blocks.gap: The Boost is used to simulate a slight overdrive/preamp boost, mimicking the Plexi's natural grit without adding excessive distortion.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary 'angry riff crunch' and bite associated with classic hard rock.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated Plexi model would be ideal, RAT-style provides the aggressive mid-range punch needed for this era of rock.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi tone and provide raw arena rock power.
Provide the classic British rock cabinet sound and necessary upper-mid clarity.
Enhance the upper mids for maximum 'Plexi bite' and cut excessive low-end mud.
Placeholder for potential filter sweeps, kept inactive as per 'avoid' list.
blocks.gap: The V-Wah is included to satisfy the required WAH slot but will be bypassed since no wah effect was requested or needed.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder for modulation. Kept inactive as per 'avoid' list and focus on dry crunch.
blocks.gap: The Chorus is included to satisfy the required MOD slot but will be bypassed, focusing instead on direct tone shaping.

blocks.purpose: Placeholder for delay. Kept inactive as per 'avoid' list and focus on tight riffing.
blocks.gap: The Digital Delay is included to satisfy the required DLY slot but will be bypassed, maintaining a dry sound.

blocks.purpose: Add minimal 'light room' ambience to give the riffing space without losing tightness.
blocks.gap: The requirement was for a dry sound, so the reverb is kept very low (15%) to provide only subtle air and dimension.
